AUTHOR: Marini
TITLE: Tracking Fish Abundance by Underwater Image Recognition
REGION: Western Mediterranean, OBSEA cabled observatory, Vilanova i la Geltru, Catalonia, Spain
SPECIES: fish (binary fish / non-fish RoI classifier, no species discrimination)
DATA: Own footage: OBSEA still images at 30-min frequency, 2012 (train/val) and 2013 (test)
V_EV: Methods, Image Recognition: 'the level of water turbidity varies from 0 to 3, as follows: clear water, low turbidity, moderate turbidity and high turbidity'; Fig. 5 stratified by score
D2: 2012: 1,191 images (10% of 11,920) for training/validation via 10-fold CV on RoIs; 2013: 10,961 images for test
D_EV: Results: 'randomly sampling a subset of images that were acquired in the year 2012' ... 'then tested on images that were acquired in the year 2013'
R_EV: Results: 'The learnt image classifier was then tested on images that were acquired in the year 2013, where 10,961 images were manually scored'
C_EV: no statement found (binary GP classifier output 1/0; no confidence threshold or FP verification reported)
E_EV: Test of the Image Classifier: 'The Pearson Correlation between the abundance time series resulting from the observation and the abundance time series produced by the automated image classifier'
ARCH: Image differencing segmentation of consecutive frames + handcrafted texture/shape features on RoIs + genetic-programming binary classifier selected by stratified 10-fold CV
METR: Validation accuracy, TPR, FPR (10-fold CV); Pearson correlation between automated and manual count time series at 30-min, daily, monthly scales; PERMANOVA; GLM
NOTE: Non-deep-learning (genetic programming) method. Split is temporal: 2012 images for training/validation, 2013 for test (coded as 조사일 since the unit is acquisition year, the nearest allowed value). Turbidity is a manual ordinal score 0-3 (not instrument-measured) so V1 = 정성 서술만 and V6 = P; results also stratified by bio-fouling score. Depth 20 m and LED lighting (2900 lumen) reported (V2, V3). R1 = N because all data are from one observatory/camera; a verifier may consider the different-year test as a temporal external test (then R1 = Y, R2 = 계절/시기, R3 = Y). Classifier outputs binary 0/1 so no confidence threshold is reported; false positives/negatives are discussed qualitatively (PTZ errors, crowded scenes) but no verified FP rate on test detections, hence C_ALL = NR. E4 = FNR via TPR 95% (validation, RoI level). Counts systematically underestimate manual counts (Fig. 3). ENV: Mediterranean coastal artificial reef at 20 m, closest allowed value 온대 암반/켈프. NIMG = 11,920 (2012) + 10,961 (2013).
